overview:
Massachusetts' 9th District leans Democratic by six points. Incumbent Bill Keating is running for re-election and holds a decisive financial edge, with roughly $495,000 in cash on hand to challenger Tyler MacAllister's $35,000. Prediction markets price the Democrat at about a 96% chance of holding the seat.

No public general-election polls or expert race ratings are available, so the outlook rests on the district's partisan lean, the incumbent's structural advantages, and the fundraising gap, all of which point the same way. The race sits firmly in the Safe Democratic column, with the main uncertainty coming from how a shifting national environment could affect turnout rather than any local sign of a genuine contest.
